description.html: HabiStat Botanical Calcium is a calcium carbonate supplement enriched with dried herbs and flowers. According to the manufacturer, it contains calcium carbonate (29%), magnesium carbonate, echinacea, nettle, chickweed, plantain, milk thistle, dandelion, cactus flowers, prickly pear, hibiscus flowers, mulberry leaf and bee pollen, with added vitamins A, D3 and E.

Calcium is needed for strong bones, healthy teeth and proper muscle function, and the botanical ingredients provide natural vitamins and minerals. HabiStat designed it for herbivores and omnivores such as tortoises, iguanas, bearded dragons and uromastyx.

Sprinkle it over fresh weeds, fruit and vegetables just before feeding. The manufacturer says it can be used daily and can also be added to pelleted food. Store in a cool, dry place; for animal use only.
Along with the supplement, herbivores also need UVB lighting of the right strength. See tortoise and lizard food on our lizard food page and lamps in our equipment range.

All equipment can be ordered by phone or WhatsApp message. Courier delivery across Serbia, in-person pickup in Novi Sad. For questions about the product, compatibility or recommendations for your animal - get in touch.
